niche_preference_profile: This user prefers clean, modern, information-rich UI that feels airy rather than heavy. They like layouts with clear section structure, strong hierarchy, and enough content visible at once to feel complete and useful. They favor concise, direct copy, prominent primary actions, and polished card/list treatments with good spacing and contrast. In modal or alert contexts, they prefer a focused, uncluttered presentation with a subdued background and a clear, reassuring tone.

criteria.description: Prefers screens that show more useful settings or content at once, with minimal wasted space and a layout that feels populated rather than sparse.
Prefers clearly separated, well-grouped sections with strong hierarchy and organized rows/cards instead of fragmented or under-structured layouts.
Prefers airy, lightweight interfaces with balanced spacing, low visual heaviness, and less bulky card treatment or dark-heavy styling.
Prefers broader, more complete option sets and populated screens that include expected categories, item metadata, and visible controls.
Prefers short, direct, easy-to-scan copy that focuses on the core message and avoids extra explanation, tips, or bureaucratic wording.
Prefers a clearly emphasized main action button that stands out visually and is easy to identify as the next step.
